# Frontend: Angular and TypeScript

Primary app: `frontend/clients/main/` (Angular 21, Angular Material). Future apps go under `frontend/clients/`. Source: `src/app/` (`components/` by feature, `data/` constants, `directives/`, `guards/`, `interceptors/`, `services/`, `types/`), `assets/`, `environments/`, `locale/`, `styles/`.

## App conventions

- Put reusable UI in `components/common/` or style-guide patterns; avoid duplicating Material wrappers; use existing services (dialog, snackbar, icon, loader).
- Keep static definitions in `data/` (`api-routes.ts`, `app-routes.ts`, `icon-list.ts`, `localstorage-keys.ts`, `sidebar-navigation.ts`); keep shared types in `types/`.
- Protect routes with guards (`permissionGuard` + `requiredPermission`); don't scatter ad-hoc auth checks in components when a guard fits. Roles must match the backend endpoints.
- Use `environments/` for environment-dependent values; don't hard-code API bases in components.
- Mark user-facing text for translation (`i18n`, `$localize`).

## TypeScript and Angular

- Use strict type checking; prefer inference when the type is obvious; avoid `any` (use `unknown`).
- Always use standalone components over NgModules. Must NOT set `standalone: true` (default in Angular v20+).
- Do NOT set `changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush` explicitly (`OnPush` is the default in Angular v22+).
- Use signals for state management. Implement lazy loading for feature routes; existing feature areas register components directly, so match an area's existing style when extending it.
- Do NOT use `@HostBinding` / `@HostListener`; use the `host` object of `@Component` / `@Directive`.
- Use `NgOptimizedImage` for all static images (not for inline base64 images).

## Components, state and services

- Small, single-responsibility components; `input()` / `output()` functions, `model()` for two-way binding, `computed()` for derived state, `linkedSignal()` for state derived from several sources that must stay synchronized.
- Prefer inline templates for small components; external template/style paths relative to the component TS file.
- Prefer Signal Forms (`@angular/forms/signals`, stable in v22+) for new forms; otherwise Reactive forms, not template-driven.
- Do NOT use `ngClass` / `ngStyle`; use `class` / `style` bindings.
- Signals for local state; pure, predictable transformations; never `mutate` (use `update` or `set`).
- Services: single responsibility, `providedIn: 'root'` for singletons, prefer `@Service` over `@Injectable({providedIn: 'root'})` for new singletons (v22+), `inject()` instead of constructor injection.
- Selectors: components `app-` kebab-case, directives `app`/`custom` camelCase. Add a `*.spec.ts` next to new code; `npm run lint` and `npm test` must pass.

Details: `docs/standards/frontend-angular.md` (including the Angular 21 version note), `docs/frontend/index.md`, `docs/guides/routes-and-guards.md`.
